```python
def remote_write_command(remote_dir: str, name: str, *, exclusive: bool = False) -> str:
    """The remote shell command that stores stdin as ``remote_dir/name`` atomically.

    The bytes go to a dot-named temporary file in the final file's own directory (``name`` may carry
    sub-directories, which are created) and are renamed over the final name; when the write fails the temporary
    file is removed and the previous final file is left as it was. ``exclusive`` refuses to replace an existing final
    file (the append-only history), leaving it as it was.
    """
    final = PurePosixPath(remote_dir) / name
    tmp = final.parent / f".{final.name}.tmp"
    q_dir, q_final, q_tmp = (shlex.quote(str(p)) for p in (final.parent, final, tmp))
    guard = f"[ ! -e {q_final} ] && " if exclusive else ""
    move = "mv -n" if exclusive else "mv -f"
    return (
        f"umask 022 && mkdir -p {q_dir} && {guard}"
        f"{{ cat > {q_tmp} && {move} {q_tmp} {q_final}; }} || {{ rm -f {q_tmp}; exit 1; }}"
    )


def snapshot_name(

    stem, dot, ext = PurePosixPath(record_name).name.rpartition(".")

        stem, ext = ext, ""
    stamp = moment.astimezone(UTC).strftime(history.timestamp_format)
    return f"{history.subdirectory}/{stem}-{stamp}{dot}{ext}"


def _snapshot_time(
    history: ModelPublishHistory, record_name: str, file_name: str
) -> datetime | None:
    """The UTC time a history file name carries, or ``None`` when it is not one of this record's snapshots."""
    stem, dot, ext = PurePosixPath(record_name).name.rpartition(".")
    if not dot:
        stem, ext = ext, ""
    head, tail = f"{stem}-", f"{dot}{ext}"
    if not (file_name.startswith(head) and file_name.endswith(tail)):
        return None
    stamp = file_name[len(head) : len(file_name) - len(tail)]
    try:
        return datetime.strptime(stamp, history.timestamp_format).replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def prunable_snapshots(
    history: ModelPublishHistory,
    record_name: str,
    file_names: Sequence[str],
    now: datetime,

    A name that is not a snapshot of this record is never listed, and a snapshot inside the window never is.

    cutoff = now.astimezone(UTC) - timedelta(days=history.retention.days)
    dated = sorted(

        if (t := _snapshot_time(history, record_name, n)) is not None

def _within_seconds[T](seconds: float, work: Callable[[], T], message: str) -> T:
    """The result of ``work``, or ``TimeoutError(message)`` once ``seconds`` have passed.

    The work runs in a daemon thread so a stuck read or a backtracking pattern cannot hold the publication: the caller
    reports the step failed and goes on. The thread is left to finish on its own; it holds no lock the cycle needs.
    """
    outcome: list[T] = []
    failure: list[BaseException] = []

    def target() -> None:
        try:
            outcome.append(work())
        except BaseException as exc:
            failure.append(exc)

    worker = threading.Thread(target=target, daemon=True)
    worker.start()
    worker.join(seconds)
    if worker.is_alive():
        raise TimeoutError(message)
    if failure:
        raise failure[0]
    return outcome[0]

class PhaseBudget:
    """The seconds one phase of a run may still use (OMN-22699): every call in the phase is clamped to what is left."""

    def __init__(
        self, clock: Callable[[], float], seconds: int, phase: str, cap: int
    ) -> None:
        self._clock = clock
        self._end = clock() + seconds
        self._phase = phase
        self._cap = cap

    def remaining(self) -> float:
        return self._end - self._clock()

    def timeout(self) -> int:
        """The limit for the next call: the transfer limit or what the phase has left, whichever is less."""
        left = math.floor(self.remaining())
        if left <= 0:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the {self._phase} budget of this cycle is spent; files already replaced earlier in this phase stay replaced"
            )
        return min(self._cap, left)

def copy_to_server(
    run: Runner,
    rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
    overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
    name: str,
    payload: bytes,
    *,
    root: str | None = None,
    history: bool = False,
    exclusive: bool = False,
    budget: PhaseBudget | None = None,
    local_root: Path | None = None,
    unreachable: set[str] | None = None,
) -> CopyOutcome:
    """Store ``payload`` as ``name`` on the publishing machine and on every serving host over ssh; a failed host keeps its old file.

    The local copy (``local_root``, when the overlay names one) is written first, so it holds the file even when every
    host is down. Each serving host is tried on its own: one host failing never stops another from being served, and a
    host whose connection did not open is skipped for the rest of the run (``unreachable``). The call raises
    ``PublishRefusedError`` only when no serving host stored the file. ``root`` writes under one explicit directory of
    a single-host overlay (the access include); ``history`` writes under each host's own history root.

    With a ``budget`` each attempt and each wait between attempts is clamped to what the phase has left.
    """
    outcome = CopyOutcome()
    targets = overlay.targets
    if root is not None and len(targets) > 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "an explicit root names a path on one host: pass a single-host overlay"
        )
    if local_root is not None and root is None:
        try:
            _write_local_copy(local_root, name, payload, exclusive=exclusive)
        except OSError as exc:
            outcome.failed["local"] = f"writing {name} to the local copy failed: {exc}"
    down = unreachable if unreachable is not None else set()
    fanned = len(targets) > 1

    def limit() -> int:
        return (
            budget.timeout()
            if budget is not None
            else rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds
        )

    def one(target: ModelPublishTarget) -> str | None:
        """The reason this host did not store the file, or ``None`` when it did."""
        if target.ssh_target in down:
            return "unreachable earlier in this run; skipped"
        view = overlay.for_target(target)
        directory = root or (target.history_root if history else target.remote_dir)
        argv = ssh_argv(
            rt, view, remote_write_command(directory, name, exclusive=exclusive)
        )
        try:
            done = run(argv, payload, limit())
            # A fanned-out publish does not retry a connection that did not open: the other host is served now and this one on the
            # next run, so a down host costs one connect timeout, not a retry ladder per file.
            for _ in range(0 if fanned else SSH_CONNECT_RETRIES):
                if done.returncode != SSH_CONNECTION_ERROR:
                    break
                # ssh's own exit 255 is a connection that did not open (2026-11-02 18:23Z: "Network is unreachable" for a few
                # seconds on the launching Mac refused a whole 10-minute run); the remote command did not run, so it is tried again.
                wait = SSH_RETRY_SECONDS
                if budget is not None:
                    wait = max(0.0, min(wait, budget.remaining()))
                time.sleep(wait)
                done = run(argv, payload, limit())
        except PublishRefusedError as exc:
            return str(exc)
        if done.returncode == 0:
            return None
        if done.returncode == SSH_CONNECTION_ERROR:
            down.add(target.ssh_target)
        return (
            f"publishing {name} failed with exit {done.returncode}: {_tail(done.stderr)}; "
            "the previous file on the server is untouched"
        )

    if fanned:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(targets)) as pool:
            reasons = list(pool.map(one, targets))
    else:
        reasons = [one(targets[0])]
    for target, reason in zip(targets, reasons, strict=True):
        if reason is None:
            outcome.delivered.append(target.ssh_target)
        else:
            outcome.failed[target.ssh_target] = reason
    if not outcome.delivered:
        raise PublishRefusedError(
            str(reasons[0])
            if not fanned
            else "; ".join(
                f"{t.ssh_target}: {r}" for t, r in zip(targets, reasons, strict=True)
            )
        )
    return outcome

            (rt.names.status, status),

        if simple_reads is not None:
            files.append((rt.names.simple_reads, simple_reads))
        if simple_data is not None:
            files.append((rt.names.simple_data, simple_data))
        if compare_data is not None:
            files.append((rt.names.compare_data, compare_data))
        if tracker_data is not None:
            files.append((rt.names.delegation_tracker_data, tracker_data))
        if health is not None:
            if health_payload.detail is not None:
                files.append((health_payload.detail_file, health_payload.detail))
            files.append((rt.names.process_health, health))
        if delegation is not None:
            files.append((rt.names.delegation, delegation))
        files.append((rt.names.data, data))
        # The snapshot is stored before the live record, so a record that is shown has always been kept.
        snapshot = snapshot_name(rt.history, rt.names.data, now)
        # The local copy is complete before any host is tried, so it holds the whole publish even when every host is down.
        self._keep_local_copy([(snapshot, data), *files], snapshot)
        copy_start = self._clock()
        copy_budget = PhaseBudget(
            self._clock,
            rt.cycle.copy_budget_seconds,
            "copy",
            rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds,
        )
        try:
            self._tally.record(
                copy_to_server(
                    self._run,
                    rt,
                    overlay,
                    snapshot,
                    data,
                    history=True,
                    exclusive=True,
                    budget=copy_budget,
                    unreachable=self._unreachable,
                )
            )
            for name, payload in files:
                self._copy(rt, overlay, name, payload, copy_budget)
        finally:
            phases["copy"] = self._clock() - copy_start
        prune_start = self._clock()
        try:
            pruned = self._prune_history(rt, overlay, now)
        finally:
            phases["history_prune"] = self._clock() - prune_start

        # The page and the record are served. The canary status is published from them, so its floor age is the page's.
        after: list[ModelPublishStepResult] = []
        after_start = self._clock()
        for after_step in rt.after_publish_steps:
            after_result = self._step(
                after_step, home, overlay, rt.plugin_root_env, env
            )
            after.append(after_result)
            if after_result.status == "failed" and after_step.required:
                phases["after_publish"] = self._clock() - after_start
                failed_timing = self._timing(cycle_start, phases, results, after)
                if request.state_dir:
                    self._write_evidence(
                        Path(request.state_dir) / rt.evidence_file,
                        now,
                        generated_at,
                        hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                        tuple(name for name, _ in files),
                        failed_timing,
                    )
                self._write_final_status(
                    rt, overlay, status_document, failed_timing, after
                )
                raise PublishRefusedError(
                    f"the page was served but the required step {after_step.name} failed "
                    f"({after_result.detail}): {after_result.diagnostic}"
                )

        phases["after_publish"] = self._clock() - after_start
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        timing = self._timing(cycle_start, phases, results, after)
        if request.state_dir:
            self._write_evidence(
                Path(request.state_dir) / rt.evidence_file,
                now,
                generated_at,
                digest,
                tuple(name for name, _ in files),
                timing,
            )
        self._write_final_status(rt, overlay, status_document, timing, after)
        return ModelFactoryFloorPublishResult(
            published=tuple(name for name, _ in files),
            generated_at=generated_at,
            data_sha256=digest,
            serve_url=overlay.serve_url,
            steps=tuple(results),
            cycle_seconds=timing["cycle_seconds"],
            phase_seconds={k: round(v, 3) for k, v in phases.items()},
            after_publish=tuple(after),
            process_health_published=health is not None,
            delegation_published=delegation is not None,
            history_snapshot=snapshot,
            history_pruned=pruned,
            serve_urls=overlay.serve_urls,
            served_to=self._tally.served_to(),
            failed_targets=dict(self._tally.failed),
            local_copy=overlay.local_copy_relpath or "",
        )

    def _keep_local_copy(
        self, files: Sequence[tuple[str, bytes]], snapshot: str
    ) -> None:
        """Write every file of this publish under the overlay's local copy directory; a failure is named in the tally, never raised."""
        if self._local_root is None:
            return
        try:
            for name, payload in files:
                _write_local_copy(
                    self._local_root,
                    name,
                    payload,
                    exclusive=name == snapshot,
                )
        except OSError as exc:
            self._tally.failed.setdefault(
                "local", f"the local copy could not be written: {exc}"
            )

    def _prune_history(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Remove the past-window snapshots the retention allows on each serving host; only files inside the history subdirectory are named.

        A host that cannot be pruned is named in the tally and does not stop the others; the call raises only when no host could be pruned.
        """
        pruned: list[str] = []
        reasons: list[str] = []
        pruned_any = False
        for target in overlay.targets:
            if target.ssh_target in self._unreachable:
                reasons.append(f"{target.ssh_target}: unreachable; nothing was pruned")
                continue
            try:
                pruned.extend(self._prune_target(rt, overlay.for_target(target), now))
                pruned_any = True
            except PublishRefusedError as exc:
                reasons.append(f"{target.ssh_target}: {exc}")
                self._tally.failed.setdefault(target.ssh_target, str(exc))
        if not pruned_any and reasons:
            raise PublishRefusedError("; ".join(reasons))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(pruned))

    def _prune_target(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        directory = str(PurePosixPath(overlay.history_root) / rt.history.subdirectory)
        budget = PhaseBudget(
            self._clock,
            rt.cycle.history_prune_budget_seconds,
            "history prune",
            rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds,
        )
        listing = self._run(
            ssh_argv(rt, overlay, f"ls -1 -- {shlex.quote(directory)}"),
            None,
            budget.timeout(),
        )
        if listing.returncode != 0:
            if listing.returncode == SSH_CONNECTION_ERROR:
                self._unreachable.add(overlay.ssh_target)
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"listing the history failed with exit {listing.returncode}: {_tail(listing.stderr)}; "
                "nothing was pruned"
            )
        found = listing.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").split("\n")
        doomed = prunable_snapshots(rt.history, rt.names.data, found, now)
        if not doomed:
            return ()
        paths = " ".join(shlex.quote(f"{directory}/{n}") for n in doomed)
        done = self._run(
            ssh_argv(rt, overlay, f"rm -f -- {paths}"),
            None,
            budget.timeout(),
        )
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"pruning the history failed with exit {done.returncode}: {_tail(done.stderr)}"
            )
        return doomed

    @staticmethod
    def _groups(steps: Sequence[ModelPublishStep]) -> list[list[ModelPublishStep]]:
        """The steps in contract order, consecutive ``concurrent`` ones in one group."""
        return group_steps(steps)

    def _run_group(
        self,
        group: Sequence[ModelPublishStep],
        home: Path,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        env: Mapping[str, str],
    ) -> list[ModelPublishStepResult]:
        """The results of one group, in the group's order; a group of several runs its steps in threads."""
        if len(group) == 1:
            return [self._step(group[0], home, overlay, rt.plugin_root_env, env)]
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(group)) as pool:
            futures = [
                pool.submit(self._step, step, home, overlay, rt.plugin_root_env, env)
                for step in group
            ]
            return [future.result() for future in futures]

    def _timing(
        self,
        cycle_start: float,
        phases: Mapping[str, float],
        results: Sequence[ModelPublishStepResult],
        after: Sequence[ModelPublishStepResult],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The cycle's measured seconds: the total, each phase, and each step with the slowest named."""
        steps = {r.name: r.seconds for r in (*results, *after)}
        slowest = max(steps, key=lambda name: steps[name], default="")
        return {
            "cycle_seconds": round(self._clock() - cycle_start, 3),
            "phase_seconds": {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in phases.items()},
            "step_seconds": steps,
            "slowest_step": slowest,
        }

    def _step(
        self,
        step: ModelPublishStep,
        home: Path,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        plugin_root_env: str,
        env: Mapping[str, str],
    ) -> ModelPublishStepResult:
        """One step, with the seconds it took."""
        started = self._clock()
        result = self._run_step(step, home, overlay, plugin_root_env, env)
        return result.model_copy(update={"seconds": round(self._clock() - started, 3)})

    def _run_step(
        self,
        step: ModelPublishStep,
        home: Path,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        plugin_root_env: str,
        env: Mapping[str, str],
    ) -> ModelPublishStepResult:
        def fill(values: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
            plugin_root = env.get(plugin_root_env, "").strip()
            if not plugin_root and any("{plugin_root}" in v for v in values):
                raise PublishRefusedError(
                    f"{plugin_root_env} is not set (fail fast, no default): export the plugin root"
                )
            return [
                v.replace("{home}", str(home))
                .replace("{bus_lane}", overlay.bus_lane)
                .replace("{plugin_root}", plugin_root)
                for v in values
            ]

        def failed(detail: str, diagnostic: str = "") -> ModelPublishStepResult:
            return ModelPublishStepResult(
                name=step.name, status="failed", detail=detail, diagnostic=diagnostic
            )

        if step.fresh_relpath is not None and step.fresh_seconds is not None:
            try:
                age = time.time() - (home / step.fresh_relpath).stat().st_mtime
            except OSError:
                age = step.fresh_seconds
            if 0 <= age < step.fresh_seconds:
                return ModelPublishStepResult(name=step.name, status="ok")
        try:
            if step.kind == "runner_fleet":
                if step.output_relpath is None:
                    raise ValueError("a fleet source step names an output")
                reading = (
                    HandlerFleetObservationSource(self._run)
                    .handle(
                        ModelFleetObservationSourceRequest(
                            timeout_seconds=step.timeout_seconds
                        ),
                        environ=env,
                    )
                    .document
                )
                write_atomic(home / step.output_relpath, json.dumps(reading).encode())
                if reading["status"] != "read":
                    return failed("producer unread", str(reading["reason"]))
                return ModelPublishStepResult(name=step.name, status="ok")
            if step.kind == "friction_rollup":
                if step.rollup is None or step.output_relpath is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "a friction rollup step names its settings and an output"
                    )
                settings = step.rollup
                report = _within_seconds(
                    step.timeout_seconds,
                    lambda: HandlerFrictionRollupSource().handle(
                        settings, now=self._wall_clock(), environ=env
                    ),
                    f"the friction rollup ran past its {step.timeout_seconds} s budget",
                )
                write_atomic(
                    home / step.output_relpath,
                    json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"),
                )
                return ModelPublishStepResult(name=step.name, status="ok")
            if step.kind == "copy":
                if step.source_relpath is None or step.output_relpath is None:
                    raise ValueError("a copy step names a source and an output")
                raw = (home / step.source_relpath).read_bytes()
                document = json.loads(raw)
                for key in step.select:
                    if not isinstance(document, dict) or key not in document:
                        raise ValueError(f"the source has no {'.'.join(step.select)}")
                    document = document[key]
                if step.select:
                    raw = json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
                write_atomic(home / step.output_relpath, raw)
                return ModelPublishStepResult(name=step.name, status="ok")
            if step.kind == "module":
                if step.module is None:
                    raise ValueError("a module step names a module")
                argv = [sys.executable, "-m", step.module, *fill(step.args)]
            else:
                argv = fill(step.argv)
            done = self._run(argv, None, step.timeout_seconds)
        except (OSError, ValueError, PublishRefusedError) as exc:
            return failed(type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
        if done.returncode != 0:
            return failed(f"exit {done.returncode}", _tail(done.stderr))
        if step.kind == "capture":
            if step.output_relpath is None:
                return failed("ValueError", "a capture step names an output")
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(done.stdout)
            except ValueError:
                return failed("output is not JSON", _tail(done.stdout))
            if not isinstance(parsed, list):
                return failed("output is not a JSON list")
            write_atomic(home / step.output_relpath, done.stdout)
        return ModelPublishStepResult(name=step.name, status="ok")

    @staticmethod
    def _read_record(path: Path) -> bytes:
        try:
            data = path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the factory floor record {path} is unreadable ({type(exc).__name__}); "
                "run node_factory_floor_effect first"

    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:

    @staticmethod
    def _flag_undrawn(
        results: list[ModelPublishStepResult],
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        declared: tuple[str, ...] | None,
        lines: Sequence[object],
    ) -> list[ModelPublishStepResult]:
        """Mark the record step not ok, naming the declared lines the record does not draw."""
        drawn = [line for line in lines if isinstance(line, dict)]
        missing = [
            token
            for token in declared or ()
            if not any(token in str(line.get("plan_path", "")) for line in drawn)
        ]
        if not missing:
            return results
        flagged = ModelPublishStepResult(
            name=rt.record_step,
            status="failed",
            detail="declared lines not drawn: " + ", ".join(missing),
            seconds=next((r.seconds for r in results if r.name == rt.record_step), 0.0),
        )
        if any(r.name == rt.record_step for r in results):
            return [flagged if r.name == rt.record_step else r for r in results]
        return [*results, flagged]

        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        name: str,
        payload: bytes,
        budget: PhaseBudget | None = None,
    ) -> None:

                rt,
                overlay,

    @staticmethod
    def _status_bytes(document: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
        return json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")

    def _write_final_status(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        document: dict[str, Any],
        timing: Mapping[str, Any],
        after: Sequence[ModelPublishStepResult],
    ) -> None:
        """Serve the status again with the whole cycle's seconds, which the first status could not hold (OMN-22699).

        The first status goes out with the pages, before the copies and the after-publish steps ran. This one names
        every phase, the after-publish steps, the slowest step and the cycle total (taken before this write, which is
        held to ``cycle.final_status_seconds`` inside the bound). It is kept for ``record_tick``.
        """
        document.update(
            {
                "cycle_seconds": timing["cycle_seconds"],
                "phase_seconds": timing["phase_seconds"],
                "after_publish_steps": [
                    r.model_dump(exclude={"diagnostic"}) for r in after
                ],
                "slowest_step": timing["slowest_step"],
                "served_to": list(self._tally.served_to()),
                "failed_targets": dict(self._tally.failed),
            }
        )
        self._served = (rt, overlay, document)
        budget = PhaseBudget(
            self._clock,
            rt.cycle.final_status_seconds,
            "final status",
            rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds,
        )
        self._tally.record(
            copy_to_server(
                self._run,
                rt,
                overlay,
                rt.names.status,
                self._status_bytes(document),
                budget=budget,
                unreachable=self._unreachable,
            )
        )

    def record_tick(self, tick_seconds: Mapping[str, float]) -> None:
        """Serve the status once more with the seconds of the whole tick (operator access, the publish, the reports site).

        The cycle total is the publish run alone; the tick also runs the operator-access gate before it and the
        reports site after it, which no step of the cycle times. Nothing is written when no publish was served.
        """
        if self._served is None:
            return
        rt, overlay, document = self._served
        document["tick_seconds"] = {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in tick_seconds.items()}
        budget = PhaseBudget(
            self._clock,
            rt.cycle.final_status_seconds,
            "tick status",
            rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds,
        )
        self._tally.record(
            copy_to_server(
                self._run,
                rt,
                overlay,
                rt.names.status,
                self._status_bytes(document),
                budget=budget,
                unreachable=self._unreachable,
            )
        )
```

```python
"""Build the floor's friction report from the ledger through the rollup node, with the overlay home's class rules.

The report the floor read was a copy of the report the ``friction-rollup`` timer unit writes. That unit passes no
class rules, so every FRICTION row written with no ``class=`` cell stayed unclassified however many rules were
recorded (OMN-22563). This step reads the ledger through the bus, runs ``node_friction_rollup_compute`` over it with the rules and
owners the overlay home holds, and writes the 24-hour report the floor reads. The rules are the overlay's; a missing or
invalid overlay refuses the step, so the floor never draws a rule-less report as if the rules had been applied.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shlex
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import load_structured_overlay
from omnimarket.models.friction_rollup import (
    ModelFrictionRollupRequest,

    ModelFrictionClassOverlay,
    ModelFrictionRollupStepSettings,

from omnimarket.nodes.node_friction_rollup_compute.handlers.handler_friction_rollup import (
    HandlerFrictionRollup,

from omnimarket.nodes.node_reading_writer_effect.adapters.ledger_adapters import (
    CommandLedgerRowSource,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_reading_writer_effect.protocols import (
    ModelLedgerQuery,
    ProtocolLedgerRowSource,
)


def _stamp(moment: datetime) -> str:
    return moment.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def _chunks(
    since: datetime, until: datetime, hours: int
) -> Iterator[tuple[datetime, datetime]]:
    """Consecutive half-open windows of ``hours`` from ``since`` to ``until``, so no bus answer outgrows its row limit."""
    step = timedelta(hours=hours)
    low = since
    while low < until:
        high = min(low + step, until)
        yield low, high
        low = high


class HandlerFrictionRollupSource:
    """The publisher's seam from the ledger's bus reads to the rollup node's request."""

    def handle(
        self,
        settings: ModelFrictionRollupStepSettings,
        *,
        now: datetime,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        source: ProtocolLedgerRowSource | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """The window's report. Raises ``PublishRefusedError`` or ``NodeOverlayError`` naming what is missing.

        ``source`` is the injected read port; without one the command the contract's variable holds is the route.
        """
        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
        if source is None:
            argv = shlex.split(env.get(settings.ledger_read_command_env, ""))
            if not argv:
                raise PublishRefusedError(
                    f"{settings.ledger_read_command_env} is not set (fail fast, no default): export the bus read command"
                )
            source = CommandLedgerRowSource(
                argv, settings.ledger_read_timeout_seconds, settings.ledger_row_limit
            )
        overlay = load_structured_overlay(
            settings.class_overlay_id,
            ModelFrictionClassOverlay,
            env,
            file_env=settings.class_overlay_file_env,
        )
        since = now - timedelta(hours=settings.window_hours)
        raws: set[str] = set()
        # The window is half-open; one second more keeps a row stamped exactly at ``now``.
        for low, high in _chunks(
            since, now + timedelta(seconds=1), settings.ledger_chunk_hours
        ):
            for kind in settings.ledger_row_kinds:
                page = source.read(
                    ModelLedgerQuery(since=low, until=high, row_type=kind)
                )
                if page.error is not None:
                    raise PublishRefusedError(
                        f"the ledger bus read of {kind} rows failed ({page.error}): no report is drawn from a short read"
                    )
                raws.update(row.raw for row in page.rows)
        result = HandlerFrictionRollup().handle(
            ModelFrictionRollupRequest(
                sources=[
                    ModelFrictionRollupSource(
                        display="ledger-bus-read",
                        kind="markdown",
                        text="\n".join(sorted(raws)) + "\n",
                    )
                ],
                since=_stamp(since),
                until=_stamp(now),
                generated_at=_stamp(now),
                bucket_hours=settings.bucket_hours,
                umbrella_tickets=list(settings.umbrella_tickets),
                aliases=[],
                class_rules=list(overlay.class_rules),
                class_owners=list(overlay.class_owners),
            )
        )
        return result.report
```

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Serve the operator-only reports to the operator's own devices and to nobody else.

The shared factory floor site is a public website of the tailnet. A report that is for the operator alone is
published beside it but is behind a gate in the web server: the server answers 403 to every source address that is
not one of the operator's own devices. This handler builds that gate on every publish, in this order:

1. read the tailnet status on the publishing host and take the addresses of the devices that the overlay's
   ``owner_login`` owns and whose platform is one of the operator's own device classes (no address is ever written
   down; the list is re-derived each run, so a new device or a retired one is followed);
2. write the allowed-address include to the access directory beside the serving directory, over ssh, atomically;
3. reload the web server container and read its configuration back: it must carry the gate marker and every
   allowed address;
4. only then write the operator-only report pages and data to the serving directory.

When step 1, 2 or 3 fails, the operator-only files are removed from the serving directory and the publish refuses
naming the cause: a server that does not carry the gate never serves the report to everyone. A missing or invalid
``owner_login`` key refuses before anything is read, and the refusal names the key.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import shlex
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import load_structured_overlay
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_factory_floor_publish import (
    NODE_NAME,
    SSH_CONNECTION_ERROR,
    PublishRefusedError,
    Runner,
    copy_to_server,
    load_runtime,
    run_process,
    ssh_argv,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_reports_publish import (
    MANIFEST_SCHEMA,
    HandlerReportsPublish,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.models.model_factory_floor_publish import (
    ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
    ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
    ModelOperatorAccessRequest,
    ModelOperatorAccessResult,
)

OWNER_KEY = "owner_login"


def resolve_operator_addresses(
    status: Mapping[str, object], owner_login: str, operator_os: Sequence[str]
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """The tailnet addresses of the devices ``owner_login`` owns whose platform is one of ``operator_os``.

    ``status`` is the document ``tailscale status --json`` prints: a ``User`` table of id to profile (with its
    ``LoginName``) and the ``Self`` and ``Peer`` devices, each with a ``UserID``, an ``OS`` and its ``TailscaleIPs``.
    The result is sorted and holds only valid IP addresses.
    """
    users = status.get("User")
    if not isinstance(users, Mapping):
        raise PublishRefusedError(
            "the tailnet status has no User table; cannot tell which devices the owner_login overlay key owns"
        )
    wanted = owner_login.strip().lower()
    owner_ids = {
        str(user_id)
        for user_id, profile in users.items()
        if isinstance(profile, Mapping)
        and str(profile.get("LoginName", "")).strip().lower() == wanted
    }
    peers = status.get("Peer")
    devices: list[object] = [status.get("Self")]
    if isinstance(peers, Mapping):
        devices.extend(peers.values())
    found: set[str] = set()
    for device in devices:
        if not isinstance(device, Mapping):
            continue
        if str(device.get("UserID")) not in owner_ids:
            continue
        if device.get("OS") not in operator_os:
            continue
        addresses = device.get("TailscaleIPs")
        if not isinstance(addresses, list):
            continue
        for raw in addresses:
            try:
                found.add(str(ipaddress.ip_address(str(raw))))
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return tuple(sorted(found, key=lambda a: (ipaddress.ip_address(a).version, a)))


def render_include(addresses: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    """The nginx include that admits ``addresses``; the server's own ``deny all`` follows it and refuses the rest."""
    lines = [
        "# Generated by the factory floor publish on every run. Do not edit.",
        "# The operator's own devices; everything else is refused by the deny rule that follows this include.",
    ]
    lines.extend(f"allow {ipaddress.ip_address(a)};" for a in addresses)
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


class HandlerOperatorAccess:
    """Boundary of the operator-only publish: the tailnet read, the include, the reload and the copies happen here."""

    def __init__(
        self, runner: Runner = run_process, unreachable: set[str] | None = None
    ) -> None:
        self._run = runner
        self._unreachable: set[str] = unreachable if unreachable is not None else set()

    def handle(
        self,
        request: ModelOperatorAccessRequest,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> ModelOperatorAccessResult:
        """Raises ``PublishRefusedError`` or ``NodeOverlayError`` naming what is missing; the private files are withdrawn first."""
        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
        rt = load_runtime()
        overlay = load_structured_overlay(
            NODE_NAME,
            ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
            env,
            explicit=request.overlay,
            file_env=rt.overlay_file_env,
        )
        home_value = (request.home or env.get(rt.home_env, "")).strip()
        if not home_value:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"{rt.home_env} is not set (fail fast, no default): export it or pass --omni-home"
            )
        now = request.now or datetime.now(UTC)
        results: list[ModelOperatorAccessResult] = []
        failed: dict[str, str] = {}
        for target in overlay.targets:
            # Each serving host has its own gate: one host down or refusing leaves the others served (OMN-23081).
            if target.ssh_target in self._unreachable:
                failed[target.ssh_target] = "unreachable earlier in this run; skipped"
                continue
            try:
                results.append(
                    self._handle_target(
                        rt,
                        overlay.for_target(target),
                        home_value,
                        now,
                        request.skip_reports,
                    )
                )
            except PublishRefusedError as exc:
                failed[target.ssh_target] = str(exc)
        if not results:
            raise PublishRefusedError("; ".join(f"{t}: {r}" for t, r in failed.items()))
        first = results[0]
        return first.model_copy(
            update={
                "published": tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(n for r in results for n in r.published)
                ),
                "unread": tuple(dict.fromkeys(n for r in results for n in r.unread)),
                "failed_targets": failed,
            }
        )

    def _handle_target(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        home_value: str,
        now: datetime,
        skip_reports: bool,
    ) -> ModelOperatorAccessResult:
        """The gate and the operator-only files of the one serving host ``overlay`` names."""
        try:
            include, changed, count = self._build_gate(rt, overlay)
        except PublishRefusedError as exc:
            if overlay.ssh_target in self._unreachable:
                # The host did not answer: its private files cannot be withdrawn now, and it serves nothing while it is down.
                raise
            self._withdraw(rt, overlay)
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the operator-only reports are withdrawn from the serving directory: {exc}"
            ) from exc
        published, unread = (
            ((), ()) if skip_reports else self._publish(rt, overlay, home_value, now)
        )
        return ModelOperatorAccessResult(
            admitted_devices=count,
            include_sha256=hashlib.sha256(include).hexdigest(),
            include_changed=changed,
            published=published,
            unread=unread,
        )

    def _remote(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        command: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes, bytes]:
        done = self._run(
            ssh_argv(rt, overlay, command),
            None,
            rt.transport.transfer_timeout_seconds,
        )
        if done.returncode == SSH_CONNECTION_ERROR:
            self._unreachable.add(overlay.ssh_target)
        return done.returncode, done.stdout, done.stderr

    def _build_gate(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
    ) -> tuple[bytes, bool, int]:
        """Write the include, reload the server and read its configuration back; the include, whether it changed, the count."""
        access = rt.operator_reports.access
        done = self._run(
            list(access.tailscale_argv), None, rt.transport.connect_timeout_seconds
        )
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the tailnet status could not be read (exit {done.returncode}); "
                "the allowed devices cannot be derived"
            )
        try:
            status = json.loads(done.stdout)
        except ValueError:
            raise PublishRefusedError("the tailnet status is not JSON") from None
        if not isinstance(status, dict):
            raise PublishRefusedError("the tailnet status is not a JSON object")
        addresses = resolve_operator_addresses(
            status, overlay.owner_login, access.operator_os
        )
        if not addresses:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"no tailnet device of the platforms {list(access.operator_os)} is owned by the login in the "
                f"{OWNER_KEY} overlay key; check that the key matches a login in the tailnet status"
            )
        include = render_include(addresses).encode("utf-8")
        access_dir = str(
            PurePosixPath(overlay.remote_dir).parent / access.access_dirname
        )
        include_path = str(PurePosixPath(access_dir) / access.include_name)
        code, current, _ = self._remote(
            rt, overlay, f"cat -- {shlex.quote(include_path)}"
        )
        changed = code != 0 or current != include
        if changed:
            copy_to_server(
                self._run,
                rt,
                overlay,
                access.include_name,
                include,
                root=access_dir,
                unreachable=self._unreachable,
            )
        container = shlex.quote(access.container_name)
        code, _, _ = self._remote(
            rt, overlay, f"docker exec {container} nginx -s reload"
        )
        if code != 0:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the web server container {access.container_name} could not be reloaded (exit {code})"
            )
        code, dump, _ = self._remote(rt, overlay, f"docker exec {container} nginx -T")
        text = dump.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        if code != 0 or access.gate_marker not in text:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the web server's configuration does not carry the gate ({access.gate_marker!r}); "
                "redeploy docker/docker-compose.factory-floor-web.yml from the current infrastructure checkout"
            )
        missing = [a for a in addresses if f"allow {a};" not in text]
        if missing:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the web server does not read the allowed-address include ({len(missing)} of "
                f"{len(addresses)} addresses absent); mount the access directory at /etc/nginx/access"
            )
        return include, changed, len(addresses)

    def _private_names(self, rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime) -> list[str]:
        names: list[str] = []
        for entry in rt.operator_reports.entries:
            names.extend(page.remote for page in entry.pages)
            names.extend(item.remote for item in entry.data)
        names.append(rt.operator_reports.manifest)
        return names

    def _withdraw(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
    ) -> None:
        """Remove the operator-only files from the serving directory; a failed removal is as loud as a failed gate."""
        base = PurePosixPath(overlay.remote_dir)
        paths = " ".join(shlex.quote(str(base / n)) for n in self._private_names(rt))
        code, _, _ = self._remote(rt, overlay, f"rm -f -- {paths}")
        if code != 0:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the operator-only reports could not be withdrawn from the serving directory (exit {code}) "
                "and the web server does not carry the gate"
            )

    def _publish(
        self,
        rt: ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime,
        overlay: ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
        home_value: str,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], tuple[str, ...]]:
        home = Path(home_value)
        published: list[str] = []
        unread: list[str] = []
        manifest_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        for entry in rt.operator_reports.entries:
            data_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
            for item in entry.data:
                row, payload = HandlerReportsPublish.read_data(home, item)
                data_rows.append(row)
                if payload is None:
                    unread.append(f"{entry.id}:{item.remote}")
                    continue
                copy_to_server(
                    self._run,
                    rt,
                    overlay,
                    item.remote,
                    payload,
                    unreachable=self._unreachable,
                )
                published.append(item.remote)
            for page in entry.pages:
                copy_to_server(
                    self._run,
                    rt,
                    overlay,
                    page.remote,
                    HandlerReportsPublish.read_page(page.page_relpath),
                    unreachable=self._unreachable,
                )
                published.append(page.remote)
            manifest_entries.append(
                HandlerReportsPublish.manifest_entry(entry, data_rows)
            )
        manifest = json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": MANIFEST_SCHEMA,
                "published_at": now.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                "reports": manifest_entries,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            indent=1,
        ).encode("utf-8")
        copy_to_server(
            self._run,
            rt,
            overlay,
            rt.operator_reports.manifest,
            manifest,
            unreachable=self._unreachable,
        )
        published.append(rt.operator_reports.manifest)
        return tuple(published), tuple(unread)

    "render_include",
    "resolve_operator_addresses",
]
```

```python
"""Keep range observations off every floor refresh without discarding them.

Small series retain their existing wire format. A large series is represented by
its daily values and summaries, plus a separate gzip file containing the entire
original document. Only the detailed Process page downloads that file. The source
and summary bounds are declared in the publishing node's contract.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import json
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.models.model_process_health_payload import (
    ModelProcessHealthPayloadPolicy,
    ModelProcessHealthPayloadRequest,
    ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult,
)


@cache
def load_payload_policy() -> ModelProcessHealthPayloadPolicy:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"
    document = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return ModelProcessHealthPayloadPolicy.model_validate(
        document["runtime"]["process_health_payload"]
    )


class HandlerProcessHealthPayload:
    """Read once, cap allocation, and produce the two representations together."""

    def handle(
        self, request: ModelProcessHealthPayloadRequest
    ) -> ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult:
        policy = load_payload_policy()
        path = Path(request.source_path)
        try:
            if path.stat().st_size > policy.max_source_bytes:
                return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
                    reason="process-health source exceeds its byte limit"
                )
            with path.open("rb") as source:
                raw = source.read(policy.max_source_bytes + 1)
            if len(raw) > policy.max_source_bytes:
                return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
                    reason="process-health source exceeds its byte limit"
                )
            record = json.loads(raw)
        except OSError as exc:
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
                reason=f"not readable ({type(exc).__name__})"
            )
        except ValueError:
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(reason="not JSON")
        if (
            not isinstance(record, dict)
            or not isinstance(record.get("generated_at"), str)
            or not isinstance(record.get("days"), list)
            or not isinstance(record.get("summary"), dict)
        ):
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(reason="not a process-health series")
        if len(raw) <= policy.max_summary_bytes:
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(summary=raw)
        if not isinstance(record.get("range_overlay"), dict):
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
                reason="large process-health series has no range overlay"
            )
        summary = {
            key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "range_overlay"
        }
        summary["detail_file"] = policy.detail_file
        summary_bytes = json.dumps(summary, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        if len(summary_bytes) > policy.max_summary_bytes:
            return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
                reason="process-health summary exceeds its byte limit"
            )
        detail = gzip.compress(
            json.dumps(record, separators=(",", ":")).encode(), compresslevel=6, mtime=0
        )
        return ModelProcessHealthPayloadResult(
            summary=summary_bytes, detail=detail, detail_file=policy.detail_file
        )
```

```python
def _parse_time(value: object) -> datetime | None:
    """A timestamp or a bare date from a data file's own key, as an aware UTC time; ``None`` when it is neither."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        return None
    text = value.strip()
    if text.endswith(("Z", "z")):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return (
        parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC) if parsed.tzinfo is None else parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    )


def _isoz(moment: datetime) -> str:
    return moment.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


class HandlerReportsPublish:
    """Boundary of the reports publish: the data reads and the copies happen here."""

    def __init__(
        self, runner: Runner = run_process, unreachable: set[str] | None = None
    ) -> None:
        self._run = runner
        self._unreachable: set[str] = unreachable if unreachable is not None else set()

    def handle(
        self,
        request: ModelReportsPublishRequest,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> ModelReportsPublishResult:
        """Raises ``PublishRefusedError`` or ``NodeOverlayError`` naming what is missing."""
        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
        rt = load_runtime()
        overlay = load_structured_overlay(
            NODE_NAME,
            ModelFactoryFloorPublishOverlay,
            env,
            explicit=request.overlay,
            file_env=rt.overlay_file_env,
        )
        home_value = (request.home or env.get(rt.home_env, "")).strip()
        if not home_value:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"{rt.home_env} is not set (fail fast, no default): export it or pass --omni-home"
            )
        home = Path(home_value)
        now = request.now or datetime.now(UTC)
        reports = rt.reports

        files: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
        queued: set[str] = set()
        unread: list[str] = []
        manifest_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []

        def queue(remote: str, payload: bytes) -> None:
            if remote in queued:
                raise PublishRefusedError(
                    f"two reports publish {remote}; each published name is written by one report"
                )
            queued.add(remote)
            files.append((remote, payload))

        for entry in reports.entries:
            data_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
            for item in entry.data:
                row, payload = self.read_data(home, item)
                data_rows.append(row)
                if payload is None:
                    unread.append(f"{entry.id}:{item.remote}")
                elif item.publish:
                    queue(item.remote, payload)
            for page in entry.pages:
                queue(page.remote, self.read_page(page.page_relpath))
            manifest_entries.append(self.manifest_entry(entry, data_rows))

        queue(reports.index.remote, self.read_page(reports.index.page_relpath))
        manifest = json.dumps(
            {
                "schema": MANIFEST_SCHEMA,
                "published_at": _isoz(now),
                "reports": manifest_entries,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            indent=1,
        ).encode("utf-8")
        files.append((reports.manifest, manifest))

        local_root = local_copy_root(overlay, home)
        for name, payload in files:
            copy_to_server(
                self._run,
                rt,
                overlay,
                name,
                payload,
                local_root=local_root,
                unreachable=self._unreachable,
            )
        return ModelReportsPublishResult(
            published=tuple(name for name, _ in files),
            unread=tuple(unread),
            manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest(),
            index_url=overlay.serve_url.rstrip("/") + "/" + reports.index.remote,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def read_page(relpath: str) -> bytes:
        path = NODE_DIR / relpath
        try:
            return path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            raise PublishRefusedError(
                f"the packaged page {relpath} is unreadable ({type(exc).__name__})"
            ) from exc

    @staticmethod
    def read_data(
        home: Path, item: ModelReportData
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bytes | None]:
        """The manifest row of one data file and its bytes; the bytes are ``None`` when the file is unread."""
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "name": item.name,
            "remote": item.remote,
            "status": "unread",
            "as_of": None,
            "as_of_basis": None,
            "reason": "",
        }
        path = home / item.relpath
        try:
            stat = path.stat()
            if item.projection == "process_health_summary":
                health = HandlerProcessHealthPayload().handle(
                    ModelProcessHealthPayloadRequest(source_path=str(path))
                )
                if health.summary is None:
                    row["reason"] = health.reason
                    return row, None
                raw = health.summary
            elif stat.st_size > MAX_DATA_BYTES:
                row["reason"] = f"larger than {MAX_DATA_BYTES} bytes"
                return row, None
            else:
                raw = path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            row["reason"] = f"not readable ({type(exc).__name__})"
            return row, None
        if item.remote.endswith(".json") or item.as_of_key:
            try:
                document = json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:
                row["reason"] = "not JSON"
                return row, None
            if item.as_of_key:
                moment = _parse_time(
                    document.get(item.as_of_key) if isinstance(document, dict) else None
                )
                if moment is None:
                    row["reason"] = f"no readable time at key {item.as_of_key}"
                    return row, None
                row["as_of"] = _isoz(moment)
                row["as_of_basis"] = f"the file's own {item.as_of_key} value"
        else:
            try:
                raw.decode("utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                row["reason"] = "not UTF-8 text"
                return row, None
        if row["as_of"] is None:
            row["as_of"] = _isoz(datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime, UTC))
            row["as_of_basis"] = "the file's modified time"
        row["status"] = "read"
        return row, raw

    @staticmethod
    def manifest_entry(
        entry: ModelReportEntry, data_rows: list[dict[str, object]]
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "id": entry.id,
            "title": entry.title,
            "summary": entry.summary,
            "href": entry.href,
            "refresh": entry.refresh,
            "refresh_note": entry.refresh_note,
            "data": data_rows,
        }
```

```python
    host in ``extra_targets`` is served the same files (OMN-23081), so the floor survives one host being down. The URL list
    a reader may use is ``serve_urls``. ``local_copy_relpath``, relative to the registry home, is where each published

    JSON list at ``output_relpath``; ``command`` runs ``argv`` for what it writes itself and keeps nothing of its output; ``copy`` copies ``source_relpath`` to ``output_relpath`` (the JSON object at the key path ``select`` when it is given). ``{home}``,
    ``{bus_lane}`` and ``{plugin_root}`` in ``args`` and ``argv`` are the registry home, the overlay's bus lane and the plugin root. A step that is not
    ``required`` may fail: the failure is recorded in the status file and the page shows its source as unread.
    Consecutive steps marked ``concurrent`` run together, so a run takes as long as the slowest of them and not the sum
    (OMN-21733: the run took 8.5 to 10 minutes against a 300 s tick, which left the heartbeat older than twice its
    interval half the time). A step with ``fresh_relpath`` and ``fresh_seconds`` is skipped, counted ok, while that file
    under the registry home was written less than ``fresh_seconds`` ago, for an output that moves in days.
    ``runner_fleet`` mirrors the deployed projection's saved observation to ``output_relpath``;
    a failed read writes an unread cause so old counts cannot masquerade as a new read.
    ``friction_rollup`` runs the friction rollup node over the ledger named by ``rollup`` with the overlay home's class
    rules and writes its report to ``output_relpath``; a missing or invalid overlay fails the step and leaves the old file.

            "copy": bool(self.source_relpath) and bool(self.output_relpath),
            "command": bool(self.argv),

    devices as the status lists them: the owner login also owns lab hosts, and a server is not the operator's hand.
    The include file is written to ``<remote_dir's parent>/<access_dirname>/<include_name>`` on the serving host, a
    directory the web container mounts read-only and that is never inside the served directory. ``gate_marker`` is a

    operator_os: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)

class ModelPublishCycle(BaseModel):
    """The cycle bound the contract names, and the time each phase after the input steps is allowed (OMN-22699).

    The input steps carry their own ``timeout_seconds``. The delegation read, the copies, the history prune and the
    final status write are held to the numbers here: the handler clamps every call to what its phase has left, so the
    longest path the contract allows (``ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime.declared_longest_path``) is a real bound.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    # The seconds one publish run may take on its longest declared path; the served status names it beside the seconds taken.
    bound_seconds: int = Field(gt=0)
    delegation_timeout_seconds: int = Field(gt=0)
    # All the copies of one run (the snapshot, the pages, the data and the first status) share this; a copy that finds it spent is refused.
    copy_budget_seconds: int = Field(gt=0)
    history_prune_budget_seconds: int = Field(gt=0)
    # The final status write, which carries the whole cycle's seconds.
    final_status_seconds: int = Field(gt=0)


def group_steps(steps: Sequence[ModelPublishStep]) -> list[list[ModelPublishStep]]:
    """The steps in contract order, consecutive ``concurrent`` ones in one group."""
    groups: list[list[ModelPublishStep]] = []
    for step in steps:
        if step.concurrent and groups and groups[-1][-1].concurrent:
            groups[-1].append(step)
        else:
            groups.append([step])
    return groups


class ModelFactoryFloorPublishRuntime(BaseModel):
    """The ``runtime`` block of contract.yaml."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    home_env: str = Field(min_length=1)
    plugin_root_env: str = Field(min_length=1)
    overlay_file_env: str = Field(min_length=1)

    simple_reads_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    # OMN-23018: the running comparison page and what node_floor_compare_effect writes (relative to the registry home).
    compare_page_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    compare_data_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    # OMN-23081: the delegation tracker page and what node_floor_delegation_effect writes (relative to the registry home).
    delegation_tracker_page_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    delegation_tracker_data_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    floor_page_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    # The directory, relative to the node, holding the vendored theme files named by ``names.theme_css``.
    theme_css_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    # The directory, relative to the node, holding the icon files named by ``names.icons``.
    icons_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    evidence_file: str = Field(min_length=1)
    source: ModelPublishSource
    process_health_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    process_health_payload: ModelProcessHealthPayloadPolicy
    delegation_relpath: str = Field(min_length=1)
    lines_overlay: ModelLinesOverlay
    # The step whose status the record's completeness is judged on: not ok while a declared line is not drawn.
    record_step: str = Field(min_length=1, pattern=r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$")
    steps: tuple[ModelPublishStep, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    # Steps run after the page and the record are served, in order, never concurrently. The canary status is published
    # here, from the page as served, so its floor age is the age of the page a reader gets. A required step that fails
    # raises after the page is served: a failed page upload stops the run before these steps, so the canary status
    # then ages past its bound and reads as silent, and a failed canary publish is a failed run, never a hidden one.
    after_publish_steps: tuple[ModelPublishStep, ...]
    names: ModelPublishNames
    transport: ModelPublishTransport
    cycle: ModelPublishCycle
    history: ModelPublishHistory
    reports: ModelReportsRuntime
    operator_reports: ModelOperatorReportsRuntime

    def declared_longest_path(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        """The seconds each phase may take at most, from the timeouts this contract declares.

        The input steps run in groups: a group of concurrent steps takes its slowest member's timeout, and the groups
        add up. The after-publish steps add up. The other phases are the cycle block's own numbers, which the handler
        enforces. Their sum is the longest path a run may take; ``cycle.bound_seconds`` must hold it.
        """
        return {
            "input_steps": sum(
                max(step.timeout_seconds for step in group)
                for group in group_steps(self.steps)
            ),
            "delegation": self.cycle.delegation_timeout_seconds,
            "copy": self.cycle.copy_budget_seconds,
            "history_prune": self.cycle.history_prune_budget_seconds,
            "after_publish": sum(s.timeout_seconds for s in self.after_publish_steps),
            "final_status": self.cycle.final_status_seconds,
        }
```

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The tick entry: ``--omni-home`` and ``--state-dir`` are the registry module tick's two flags."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import NodeOverlayError
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_delegation_report import (
    HandlerDelegationReport,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_factory_floor_publish import (
    HandlerFactoryFloorPublish,
    PublishRefusedError,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_operator_access import (
    HandlerOperatorAccess,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_reports_publish import (
    HandlerReportsPublish,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.models.model_delegation_report import (
    ModelDelegationReportRequest,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.models.model_factory_floor_publish import (
    ModelFactoryFloorPublishRequest,
    ModelOperatorAccessRequest,
    ModelReportsPublishRequest,
)


def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="factory_floor_publish",
        description="Refresh the factory floor inputs and record and publish them with the page to the serving host.",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--omni-home",
        dest="registry_home",
        help="the registry home; default: the contract's home_env",
    )
    ap.add_argument("--state-dir", help="where last-run.json is written; default: none")
    ap.add_argument(
        "--skip-refresh",
        action="store_true",
        help="publish the record already on disk without running the factory floor effect",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--skip-reports",
        action="store_true",
        help="publish only the factory floor, not the reports site beside it",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--delegation-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="read delegation projection windows without publishing",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--tick",
        action="store_true",
        help="print the delegation read as one session tick line",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--lanes-running", type=int, help="live lane count from the caller's lane read"
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--probe",
        action="store_true",
        help="make a small real call through each bound local chat backend",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--refresh-delegation",
        action="store_true",
        help="refresh delegation even when other source refreshes are skipped",
    )
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if args.tick and (not args.delegation_only or args.lanes_running is None):
        ap.error("--tick requires --delegation-only and --lanes-running")
    if args.lanes_running is not None and args.lanes_running < 0:
        ap.error("--lanes-running must be nonnegative")
    return args


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    a = parse_args(argv)
    if a.delegation_only:
        reading = HandlerDelegationReport().handle(
            ModelDelegationReportRequest(
                probe=a.probe, lanes_running=a.lanes_running or 0
            )
        )
        sys.stdout.write(
            (reading.tick if a.tick else json.dumps(reading.report, indent=2)) + "\n"
        )
        return 0 if reading.report["status"] == "read" else 2
    # The operator-only gate comes first: no file is published to a server that does not carry it. A refusal there
    # withdraws the operator-only reports, is reported, and does not hold the shared pages back (the exit code stays 2).
    gate_refused = False
    # The serving hosts whose connection did not open: the three steps share the list, so a down host costs one connect timeout (OMN-23081).
    unreachable: set[str] = set()
    run_start = time.monotonic()
    access_start = run_start
    access_seconds = 0.0
    try:
        access = HandlerOperatorAccess(unreachable=unreachable).handle(
            ModelOperatorAccessRequest(
                home=a.registry_home, skip_reports=a.skip_reports
            )
        )
    except NodeOverlayError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"REFUSED factory-floor-publish: {exc}\n")
        return 2
    except PublishRefusedError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"REFUSED operator-access: {exc}\n")
        gate_refused = True
    else:
        access_seconds = time.monotonic() - access_start
        sys.stdout.write(
            f"operator-access: admitted_devices={access.admitted_devices} "
            f"include={access.include_sha256[:12]} changed={access.include_changed} "
            f"published={len(access.published)} files unread={','.join(access.unread) or 'none'} "
            f"seconds={access_seconds:.0f}\n"
        )
        for host, reason in access.failed_targets.items():
            sys.stderr.write(f"operator-access: host {host} not served: {reason}\n")
    request = ModelFactoryFloorPublishRequest(
        home=a.registry_home,
        state_dir=a.state_dir,
        skip_refresh=a.skip_refresh,
        refresh_delegation=a.refresh_delegation,
    )
    floor_refused = False
    publisher = HandlerFactoryFloorPublish(unreachable=unreachable)
    publish_seconds = 0.0
    publish_start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = publisher.handle(request)
    except (PublishRefusedError, NodeOverlayError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"REFUSED factory-floor-publish: {exc}\n")
        floor_refused = True
    else:
        publish_seconds = time.monotonic() - publish_start
        for step in result.steps:
            if step.status == "failed":
                sys.stderr.write(
                    f"factory-floor-publish: step {step.name} failed ({step.detail}): {step.diagnostic}\n"
                )
        sys.stdout.write(
            f"factory-floor-publish: published={','.join(result.published)} "
            f"record={result.generated_at} sha256={result.data_sha256[:12]} "
            f"steps={','.join(f'{s.name}:{s.status}:{s.seconds:.0f}s' for s in result.steps) or 'skipped'} "
            f"after_publish={','.join(f'{s.name}:{s.status}:{s.seconds:.0f}s' for s in result.after_publish) or 'none'} "
            f"served_to={','.join(result.served_to) or 'none'} "
            f"failed_targets={','.join(result.failed_targets) or 'none'} "
            f"cycle_seconds={result.cycle_seconds:.0f} "
            f"phases={','.join(f'{k}:{v:.0f}s' for k, v in result.phase_seconds.items())}\n"
        )

    def record_tick(reports_seconds: float) -> None:
        """The served status names the seconds of the whole tick, so a slow gate or reports site is seen too (OMN-22699)."""
        try:
            publisher.record_tick(
                {
                    "operator_access": access_seconds,
                    "floor_publish": publish_seconds,
                    "reports_site": reports_seconds,
                    "run": time.monotonic() - run_start,
                }
            )
        except PublishRefusedError as exc:
            sys.stderr.write(f"factory-floor-publish: tick seconds not served: {exc}\n")

    if a.skip_reports:
        record_tick(0.0)
        return 2 if gate_refused or floor_refused else 0
    reports_start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        reports = HandlerReportsPublish(unreachable=unreachable).handle(
            ModelReportsPublishRequest(home=a.registry_home)
        )
    except (PublishRefusedError, NodeOverlayError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"REFUSED reports-site-publish: {exc}\n")
        record_tick(time.monotonic() - reports_start)
        return 2
    record_tick(time.monotonic() - reports_start)
    sys.stdout.write(
        f"reports-site-publish: published={len(reports.published)} files "
        f"unread={','.join(reports.unread) or 'none'} manifest={reports.manifest_sha256[:12]} "
        f"index={reports.index_url} seconds={time.monotonic() - reports_start:.0f} "
        f"run_seconds={time.monotonic() - run_start:.0f}\n"
    )
    return 2 if gate_refused or floor_refused else 0
```

```python
SIMPLE = NODE_DIR / "page/simple.html"

def _pages() -> dict[str, Path]:
    """Every page the publish serves, by the name it is served under, read from the contract."""
    rt = load_runtime()
    pages = {
        rt.names.simple_page: NODE_DIR / rt.simple_page_relpath,
        rt.names.page: NODE_DIR / rt.page_relpath,
        rt.names.floor_page: NODE_DIR / rt.floor_page_relpath,
        rt.reports.index.remote: NODE_DIR / rt.reports.index.page_relpath,
    }
    for entry in (*rt.reports.entries, *rt.operator_reports.entries):
        for page in entry.pages:
            pages[page.remote] = NODE_DIR / page.page_relpath
    return pages


def _links(html: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    head = html.split("</head>", 1)[0]
    return [
        dict(re.findall(r'([a-z-]+)="([^"]*)"', tag))
        for tag in re.findall(r"<link\b[^>]*>", head)
    ]

    return width, height
```

```python
def served_status(include: str, source: str) -> int:

    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        if argv[0] == "tailscale":
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
                list(argv), 0, json.dumps(STATUS).encode(), b""

        command = argv[-1]
        self.commands.append(command)
        if command.startswith("docker exec"):
            if command.endswith("nginx -s reload"):
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(list(argv), 0, b"", b"")
            include = self.tmp_path / "access/operator-only.conf"
            text = (MARKER if self.carries_gate else "no gate here") + "\n"
            if include.exists():
                text += include.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(list(argv), 0, text.encode(), b"")
        return subprocess.run(
            ["sh", "-c", command], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
```
